name: template-library-loader
body: Template library loader: reads the project's `templates/` via an fs.FS rooted at it, validates it fail-fast in the templates-dir-validation order, parses each `template.yaml` into the template schema model and registers templates (template-registry) and themes (theme-registry); returns the first templates error path-qualified. Replaces template.Builtins / theme.Builtin as the single source for start, templates, gallery and reload.
